title: Orthogonal Procrustes Problem:
prompt: **Orthogonal Procrustes Problem:** Given paired embedding matrices $A, B \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$ from old and new models, prove that the orthogonal matrix $\Omega = \arg\min \|\Omega A^T - B^T\|_F$ subject to $\Omega^T \Omega = I$ is solved in closed form via SVD of $B^T A = U \Sigma V^T \implies \Omega = U V^T$.

resources.title: Orthogonal Procrustes problem
resources.why: The SVD solution for the best rotation aligning two point sets.
